name: Art Data Centres Ennis campus
aliases: Art Data Centres Tulla Road campus
summary: Six-hall, 200 MW data center campus planned by Art Data Centres on about 145 acres beside the Tulla Road on the eastern edge of Ennis, County Clare, near junction 13 of the M18. The national planning board granted permission in April 2024, and in March 2026 the High Court dismissed the last judicial review challenges after years of litigation. Investment is now put at more than EUR 1.6 billion over three phases. Phase 1, with a substation and two data halls, is due for commissioning by the end of 2028; enabling works start with diverting overhead power lines.

notes: No construction start had been reported by the sources opened; Clare FM says enabling works can now begin. Investment figures have risen across reports (EUR 1.2 billion in 2025, more than EUR 1.6 billion in 2026). Clare FM and Industrial Info give the campus as 145 acres or 1.3 million sq ft, presenting the two as equivalent although 145 acres is about 6.3 million sq ft; because neither says what the 1.3 million sq ft measures, it is not recorded as floor area. Industrial Info's six halls of slightly more than 33 MW each are not summed. The judicial review was brought by Friends of the Irish Environment, Futureproof Clare and several individuals.
